title: Compressor-01 Overspeed & Vibration Runaway Response
steps: Acknowledge overspeed and vibration alarms ALM-C01-VB on Compressor-01 console.
Verify shaft speed CMP-01-SPD; if speed exceeds 3300 RPM trip threshold, manually initiate emergency stop.
Verify mechanical governor throttle linkage and electronic speed controller servo feedback.
Monitor drive-end vibration CMP-01-VIB and bearing temperature CMP-01-TMP during coast-down.
Engage auxiliary lube oil system to prevent bearing seizure during emergency deceleration.
Lock out compressor drive motor and inspect rotor balance and coupling alignment before restart.
